adversarial_model_uncertainty_test.method: Relax each assumption from Round 57 model toward realistic physics and test whether adhesion remains identifiable.

combined_test.key_failure_mode: M3 (changing A) + M4 (time-varying adhesion) together make adhesion component TIME-VARYING and COUPLED to deformation. The constant-vs-exponential separation that made Round 57 work NO LONGER HOLDS. Adhesion grows while contact area changes, creating a signal INDISTINGUISHABLE from slow viscoelastic relaxation.
combined_test.verdict: NOT IDENTIFIABLE under combined realistic physics. The Round 57 result was an artifact of simplified assumptions.

realistic_model_M3_M4.verdict: FAILS — constant-tail method cannot distinguish adhesion growth from slow relaxation. The estimated value (0.0637) is biased +112% vs initial adhesion.

synthetic_ground_truth_test.conclusion: The identifiability method FAILS under realistic model. Adhesion is NOT recoverable when contact area changes and adhesion grows over time.

risks: EMBOLIZATION: clot may fragment during pause (no flow arrest, cardiac pulsation)
ISCHEMIC TIME: adds 2-30s of pause time to already time-critical procedure
RE-ADHESION: adhesion GROWS with contact time — pausing makes clot HARDER to retrieve (self-defeating)
CLOT MIGRATION: clot may shift during pause, invalidating measurement
feasible_only_if: Pause time <1 second (may be too short for relaxation)
Balloon guide catheter provides flow arrest (adds complexity)

first_pass_timing.finding: The adhesion measurement CANNOT be obtained before the first retrieval pass because:
reasons: Relaxation measurement requires clot engagement (beginning of retrieval)
Velocity sweep requires multiple passes (after first pass)
Measurement happens DURING retrieval, not before it
first_pass_timing.decision_value_impact: First-pass strategy selection: NOT POSSIBLE. Second-pass strategy selection: POSSIBLE but lower value (first pass already attempted, damage may be done). The commercial value proposition ('select strategy before first pass') is NOT achievable.

candidate_kill_verdict.lesson: The Round 57 identifiability result was an artifact of simplified assumptions (constant adhesion, known contact area, static pause). When the physics was made realistic, the adhesion component became confused with deformation and time-varying contact effects. The candidate was proven identifiable by choosing equations that make it so — not by surviving realistic physics.
candidate_kill_verdict.ceo_principle_applied: Don't prove an invention by choosing equations that make it identifiable. Try to destroy identifiability by making the physics more realistic. — The physics destroyed it.
